title: QuickChopper
description: Tree Chopper revolutionizes survival by instantly felling entire trees and their leaves whenever you break the base log while crouching. Built for speed and safety, it includes lag-prevention and tool-durability safeguards for smooth gameplay.
body:
QuickChopper is the definitive, high-performance solution for players who value time and efficiency in their survival world. Designed to eliminate the tedious process of manual wood gathering, this plugin allows you to fell entire trees and their leaves in a single, satisfying action. By simply crouching while breaking the base log of a tree, QuickChopper triggers a clean collapse of the entire structure, instantly adding the resources directly to your inventory.
Key Features

    One-Step Harvesting: Collapses entire trees from root to canopy with one break, saving you time and effort.

    Intelligent Durability: Equipped with built-in tool safeguards, the plugin prevents your axe from breaking during the felling process, protecting your investment.

    Lag-Free Performance: Specifically engineered to handle tree calculations efficiently, ensuring that even the largest forest clear-outs do not impact your server’s frame rate or stability.

    Seamless Integration: Built natively for modern Minecraft 26.1 and 26.2, QuickChopper integrates effortlessly with your existing server protection plugins and land-claim systems.
